description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! We're looking for an Associate Product Manager, Salesforce (8-12 month Maternity Cover) to join our Global Information Systems Team. You will be responsible for leveraging best practices, understanding internal customer needs, translating them into clear, actionable direction and working hand-in-hand with development as the voice of the business. What You’ll Be Doing Building trusted relationships and managing stakeholders; Product roadmapping & feature prioritization; Understanding and documenting business processes, requirements, scenarios, pain points; Facilitating in developing new business processes and identifying areas for optimization; Analyze and propose new solutions to improve business performance; Translating business requirements into instructions for technical teams to execute, and clarifying any issues throughout the development process; Managing the agile development process, including sprint and release planning, user acceptance testing, and other related ceremonies; Change management, including the development of training materials, communication plans, launch schedules; Cross-functional collaboration with various product & technology teams, corporate data, Go-To-Market; Contribute to the overall management and development of the IS Product Management Practice, by continuously working to establish best practices and improve ways of working. What You Need To Bring We’re a team of 100+ people located all over the globe (Canada, USA, EMEA, APAC). Our team is responsible for ensuring everyone across the organization has the tools and systems in place to effectively do their jobs. We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following: 1-2 years of demonstrated Product Management, Project Management and/or Business Analysis experience in SaaS implementations; An impressive ability to translate between business and technical stakeholders Intermediate knowledge of standard Salesforce features; Proven success managing complex projects across multiple functional groups; Usage of Agile Methodologies such as scrum; Proven ability to drive decisions, positively influence other team members, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment; Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to pivot and reprioritize across multiple projects; Demonstrated abilities in leading design workshops, proposing solutions and building corresponding artifacts; Salesforce and Scrum Master certification preferred. We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! What’s in it for you? Come live the Lightspeed experience… Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment; Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs everyday; Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact. … and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry: Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year Time off to volunteer and give back to your community To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here. Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who We Are Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.
title: Associate Product Manager, Salesforce (8-12 months Maternity Cover)

description: About Valyx Valyx is a fintech startup building an AI-native B2B revenue platform, with a focus on transforming Accounts Receivable operations. We replace fragmented, manual finance workflows with an intelligent operating system that helps finance teams automate collections, improve cash flow, and scale efficiently. About the Role We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to build our digital and offline presence, strengthen brand visibility and reputation, and drive top-of-funnel growth and inbound leads in the Indian B2B SaaS market. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience growing an Indian B2B SaaS startup, understands Indian decision-makers, and can execute across content, SEO, paid marketing, LinkedIn, outbound, and events. Key Responsibilities Own and execute the growth marketing strategy across SEO, SEM, paid media, content, LinkedIn, outbound, and events. Build digital and offline brand presence, visibility, and thought leadership. Drive top-of-funnel growth and qualified inbound leads through content, campaigns, partnerships, events, and performance marketing. Own SEO and SEM, including Google rankings, organic traffic, and paid search. Build visibility across Google and AI-powered search/answer engines. Create and manage content across blogs, landing pages, LinkedIn, email, social, videos, and thought leadership. Run and optimise campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM, and marketing automation for targeted outbound and demand generation. Plan and execute industry events, webinars, conferences, and other offline initiatives. Track performance using GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, CRM, and other analytics tools and continuously optimise for lead quality and ROI. Collaborate with Sales, Product, Design, Engineering, and Leadership to align marketing with business goals. Key KRAs Digital & offline presence, brand visibility, and reputation Top-of-funnel growth Inbound lead generation Google & AI search visibility Key KPIs Top-of-funnel traffic and engagement Qualified inbound leads Organic traffic and Google search rankings AI/answer-engine visibility Website and campaign conversion rates Paid marketing ROI and cost per lead Brand and event engagement Must-Have 4+ years of B2B SaaS marketing/growth experience Prior experience driving growth for an Indian B2B SaaS startup Strong understanding of Indian B2B decision-makers Hands-on experience in SEO, SEM, paid social, content, LinkedIn, outbound, and marketing automation Strong analytical skills with experience using GA4, Search Console, CRM, and marketing analytics tools Ability to be both strategic and hands-on Preferred Experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C), Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), finance automation, fintech, or related B2B SaaS Experience marketing to CFOs, Finance Heads, Controllers, Founders, or CXOs Experience with events, conferences, webinars, and offline brand building Experience with AI search / answer-engine optimisation Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
title: Growth Marketing Manager

description: Product Manager Handling Solutions - Sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van geautomatiseerde handling- en logistieke oplossingen bij een internationale marktleider – Onze opdrachtgever Moba is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en productie van geavanceerde systemen voor het sorteren, verpakken en verwerken van eieren. Vanuit het hoofdkantoor in Barneveld opereert de organisatie internationaal met een sterke focus op innovatie, automatisering en datagedreven oplossingen. Met systemen in meer dan 100 landen en een installed base waarin dagelijks ruim 1 miljard eieren wordt verwerkt, speelt Moba een sleutelrol in de verdere professionalisering van de sector. Binnen het portfolio van Moba vormt Handling Solutions een belangrijke pijler in de totale productielijn voor klanten. De organisatie ontwikkelt en levert automatiserings- en interne transport oplossingen die klanten helpen om interne logistieke processen efficiënter, betrouwbaarder en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Door de toenemende vraag naar automatisering, integratie en slimme intralogistieke oplossingen gaan de ontwikkelingen in dit segment sterk. Moba bevindt zich daarmee in een fase waarin de focus op dit segment van groot belang is voor het borgen van continuïteit voor de toekomst. De functie Als Product Manager Handling Solutions ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling, positionering en optimalisatie van Moba's handlingportfolio. Je werkt nauw samen met een Senior Product Manager om samen het portfoliomanagement voor dit segment vorm te geven. Waar de senior collega zich in belangrijke mate richt op de strategische koers en marktontwikkeling, krijg jij een belangrijke rol in het verder ontwikkelen van producten, oplossingen en marktinzichten vanuit een sterk technische basis. De rol bevindt zich op het snijvlak van techniek en markt. Je werkt intensief samen met R&D, Sales, Service en andere stakeholders en bent tegelijkertijd actief betrokken bij internationale klanten, toepassingen en marktontwikkelingen. Je verdiept je in technische vraagstukken, onderzoekt klantbehoeften, analyseert marktontwikkelingen en vertaalt inzichten naar verbeteringen, innovaties en nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen het portfolio. Ontwikkelingen van nieuwe oplossingen doe je in samenwerking met de interne R&D afdeling of met externe partijen. Je krijgt in deze rol de kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen het vakgebied van Product Management en stap voor stap steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid naar je toe te trekken. Deze functie is uitermate geschikt voor een ambitieuze professional die beschikt over een sterke technische basis en affiniteit heeft met material handling, automatisering of intralogistieke oplossingen, en die zich nog verder wil ontwikkelen op het gebied van productmanagement, marktoriëntatie en strategische vraagstukken. Tot je belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden behoren: Ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen en beheren van het wereldwijde portfolio van automatiserings- en intralogistieke oplossingen Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en technologische trends Vertalen van klant- en marktinzichten naar productverbeteringen en innovaties Samenwerken met R&D, Sales, Service en internationale stakeholders, en met externe toeleveranciers en ontwikkelpartners Meewerken aan roadmapontwikkeling en portfolio-management Bijdragen aan business cases en introducties van nieuwe oplossingen Onderhouden van contact met klanten en verzamelen van marktinformatie Technisch ondersteunen van commerciële en product-gerelateerde vraagstukken Bijdragen aan de verdere groei van het handlingsegment Jouw achtergrond Je bent technisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en beschikt over het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken snel te doorgronden. Je krijgt energie van het doorgronden van klantbehoeften, techniek, innovatie en productontwikkeling en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen binnen een internationale en technisch hoogwaardige omgeving. Je hoeft nog geen volledig gevormde Product Manager te zijn. Belangrijker vinden wij dat je beschikt over een sterke technische basis, aantoonbare affiniteit met material handling en het potentieel hebt om door te groeien binnen het vakgebied. Daarnaast vragen zij van jou : HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een technische richting Aantoonbare affiniteit met material handling, intralogistiek, transportsystemen of automatiseringsoplossingen Ervaring binnen een technische, industriële of machinebouwomgeving Interesse in productmanagement, marktontwikkeling en innovatie. Enige ervaring als product manager of product owner is een pré. Motivatie om klantvraagstukken te begrijpen en in staat zijn dit te vertalen naar oplossingsrichtingen. Sterke analytische vaardigheden en een gestructureerde manier van werken Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen Ambitie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen Product Management Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal Het aanbod Je komt terecht in een internationale en technologisch hoogwaardige organisatie waar je direct impact maakt op een strategisch groeidomein. Moba bied je een unieke combinatie van inhoudelijke uitdaging, samenwerking met een zeer ervaren Product Manager en volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Hierdoor krijg je de kans om versneld te groeien binnen het vakgebied van Product Management, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een belangrijk onderdeel van het Moba-portfolio. Daarnaast biedt Moba onder andere: Werken bij een wereldmarktleider binnen de internationale maakindustrie Een zichtbare rol binnen een snel ontwikkelend productsegment Samenwerken met ervaren specialisten, internationale stakeholders en externe partijen Een unieke kans voor een technisch georiënteerde professional met ambitie, die zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen een internationale marktleider en daarmee wil bijdragen aan de verdere groei van een belangrijk productsegment Veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, initiatief en eigen inbreng Een professionele, internationale en technisch gedreven werkomgeving Een goed salaris, vaste eindejaarsuitkering, bonusregeling, 40 vrije dagen en uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden Moba staat ook open voor kandidaten met aantoonbaar potentieel die toe zijn aan een volgende stap in hun carrière en zich verder willen ontwikkelen tot een zelfstandig opererende Product Manager. Standplaats Barneveld, Nederland Reageren? De werving en selectie wordt exclusief verzorgd door REP Recruitment. REP Recruitment is HR partner voor bedrijven in de Maakindustrie op het gebied van Management en Senior Commercieel niveau. Onze dienstverlening bestaat uit; Search for professionals en Interim Management. Voor meer informatie kan je contact opnemen met Rinze Stienstra, 085-086 1040 / 06-515 628 05 (ook buiten kantoortijden). Een Persoonlijkheidsanalyse maakt onderdeel uit van deze procedure.

description: Referment is working with a London-based B2B fintech SaaS company whose software helps businesses solve the operational challenges of B2B payments and cash collection — from invoice chasing to payments reconciliation. They are hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to own multi-channel demand generation. The Role You will develop and execute the growth marketing strategy across channels including PPC, SEO, email, display and social media. A significant part of the role is paid media: planning, testing, implementing and measuring multi-channel campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads and Google Ads, from audience research and creative development through to landing page optimisation and performance analysis. You will manage campaigns from conception to execution, allocate and pace media spend across the channels you manage to drive key business results, and analyse data to identify trends and opportunities for campaign optimisation and revenue growth. You will provide regular performance updates to stakeholders — working closely with leadership, marketing and sales to keep initiatives aligned with business goals — and manage relationships with external vendors and partners as needed. Staying on top of industry trends to keep the company at the forefront of growth and performance marketing is part of the remit. What We're Looking For A Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, marketing, advertising or a related field Three to five years in growth or performance marketing, with demonstrated experience building and optimising paid media campaigns, preferably in a B2B SaaS or tech environment Experience running ad campaigns in Google Ads, LinkedIn and Meta; other platforms such as YouTube, Bing, Reddit or Capterra are a plus Advanced proficiency in HubSpot, Google Analytics and Ahrefs A strong analytical mindset, with a track record of data-driven optimisation and hitting ROI targets Experience managing budgets and working cross-functionally Previous experience in an early-stage company or start-up is preferred. This could suit... a performance marketer from a B2B SaaS or fintech background who wants full ownership of the paid engine in a small team, working directly with leadership. Based in London. #Referment
title: Growth Marketing Manager (7BE68A5)

description: Product Marketing Manager – Maritime Holt Executive are delighted to be partnered with Marlink to support a critical, transformation lead Product Marketing Manager position. Working across their Maritime portfolio to strengthen and innovate the way their product and services are positioned, explained, and brought to market. Collaborating with Product Managers, Sales teams, and Marketing you will shape portfolio messaging, lead go-to-market execution, develop sales enablement materials, and bring market and customer insight back into the organisation. Key Responsibilities for the Product Marketing Manager – Maritime position: Develop and maintain clear, compelling, and customer-centric positioning for the Maritime portfolio across products, services, and solution suites. Translate complex product capabilities, technical pillars, and portfolio components into simplified value propositions, customer benefits, and differentiated market messages. Build messaging frameworks that make the Maritime portfolio easier to understand, easier to position, and easier for Sales teams to pitch effectively. Act as a key link between Product Managers, Sales, and Marketing teams to ensure strong alignment on portfolio priorities, messaging, launches, and market activation. Work with Product Managers to understand portfolio strategy, solution pillars, roadmap evolution, and product differentiators, and translate them into market-ready narratives and assets. Lead go-to-market planning and execution for portfolio launches, updates, and strategic commercial initiatives across the Maritime Business Unit. Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, solution one-pagers, value propositions, battlecards, customer narratives, and objection-handling support. Gather and synthesize customer insight, market feedback, and commercial input to strengthen portfolio messaging, relevance, and market resonance. Key Experience required for the Product Marketing Manager – Maritime position: Proven experience in product marketing, portfolio marketing, go-to-market, or a related commercial role in a B2B technology environment, ideally in telecommunications, cyber security, cloud, connectivity, or managed services. Strong capability in positioning, messaging, storytelling, sales enablement, and translating complex offerings into clear, customer-relevant value propositions, supported by a solid understanding of go-to-market principles, portfolio marketing, buyer needs, and commercial activation. Excellent ability to work across Product Management, Sales, and Marketing in a transversal, influence-based role, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Customer-centric and analytical mindset, with the ability to simplify complexity, create compelling narratives, and turn market insight into actionable recommendations. Experience in maritime is highly desirable; background in maritime digital solutions or related B2B solution environments is a strong advantage. Fluency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage. Seniority Level
title: Product Marketing Manager – Maritime

description: ClickHouse is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to build our go-to-market motion for Postgres managed by ClickHouse, a new cloud offering that pairs Postgres for transactions with ClickHouse for analytics in a single, unified data stack. You’ll work across product, field, and marketing to take this brand new offering from preview to a growing book of business. This is a build-from-scratch role at a company moving quickly. We’re open on level and will calibrate to your experience, but we’re looking for someone who has experience with Postgres or other OLTP databases. What You'll Do Develop GTM strategies and plans to drive awareness, demand, and adoption of Postgres managed by ClickHouse Craft compelling messaging, positioning, and value propositions that resonate with customers and differentiate Postgres managed by ClickHouse in the market Create marketing collateral, including website content, blogs, presentations, internal enablement content, and more Collaborate with the cross-functional team to gather market insights and understand customer needs Conduct competitive analysis to understand market trends, identify opportunities, and inform product and marketing strategies Evaluate and iterate on this strategy with metrics and feedback from stakeholders to track efficacy, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven recommendations What You'll Bring Substantial experience in product marketing, product, or a technical role, bonus points for having spent time with Postgres or another OLTP database Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely Analytical mindset with the capacity to leverage data and metrics to measure performance and inform decision-making Proven lead skills with the ability to manage multiple priority workstreams and deadlines simultaneously Team player who collaborates effectively across functions and levels Deep understanding of databases, particularly OLTP and OLAP Bonus points Experience marketing a database, data infrastructure, or developer tools product Familiarity with the Postgres ecosystem Experience at a startup or other fast-moving environment Fluency in SQL Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Equal Opportunity & Privacy ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Please see here for our Privacy Statement. Compensation Range: $200K - $280K
title: Product Marketing, Postgres

description: About this job Are you an experienced marketer who enjoys taking ownership and turning complex technology into a clear and compelling story for customers? We are looking for a Marketing Manager to take ownership of our marketing activities and help shape the next phase of our marketing function. This is a hands-on and strategic role where you will work across product marketing, digital marketing, content, campaigns, events and brand development. You will work closely with management, product, business development and technical teams, translating complex technologies and services into strong market propositions. As the organisation continues to grow, we expect to build and develop a marketing team , making this an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to grow into a broader marketing leadership role. What will you do? Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy and roadmap . Take ownership of product and proposition marketing , including positioning, messaging and go-to-market activities. Translate complex technical products and services into clear, compelling customer-facing content. Plan and optimise digital marketing activities , including website, SEO/SEA, social media and email marketing. Develop content such as product materials, case studies, articles, presentations and campaigns. Coordinate product launches, exhibitions, events and other marketing activities . Use market insights and performance data to measure and improve marketing activities. Work closely with management, Business Development, Product and Engineering teams. Manage external marketing partners and agencies where required. Establish and improve marketing processes, tools and ways of working. Help shape and eventually build a marketing team as the organisation grows. Build relationships with relevant media, industry platforms and ecosystem partners. Lead PR activities around major contracts, partnerships, product launches and strategic developments. Coordinate external PR and marketing agencies where appropriate What are we looking for? 7+ years of relevant marketing experience , including experience at Marketing Manager, Senior Marketeer or similar level. Strong experience in product marketing, product positioning and go-to-market . Experience in B2B and/or technology marketing , preferably within Space, Defence, Aerospace, High-Tech, Engineering or another technically complex industry. Strong knowledge of digital marketing , including website, SEO/SEA, social media and email marketing. Excellent communication, content creation and storytelling skills. Experience working with CMS, CRM, marketing automation and analytics tools. A proactive and independent approach, with the ability to take ownership and get things done . Strong stakeholder and project management skills. Experience working with external agencies or suppliers. Professional proficiency in English . What makes this role interesting? This is an opportunity to own and shape marketing within a growing technology organisation . You won't simply execute an existing marketing plan — you'll have the freedom to develop the strategy, strengthen product positioning, build the marketing foundation and, over time, grow the team around you . If you're an experienced B2B marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and wants to build something for the future, we'd love to hear from you. What We Offer Competitive industry salary (based on experience, full-time) A varied marketing role with plenty of ownership and responsibility. The opportunity to contribute to the growth of innovative products and technologies. A collaborative and supportive team environment where your ideas are valued. The chance to work across the full marketing mix, from digital campaigns and content creation to product launches and events. Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning. An yearly fun trip abroad with the entire company! Privacy Notice: In order to apply for this vacancy, you must submit your personal information to Science [&] Technology. Science [&] Technology will collect, use, and process your personal information as mentioned in our Privacy Policy. Our policy and processing of your personal information are compliant with the GDPR. Please note that if you do not hear back from us within 10 days of your application, you may assume that we have selected another candidate we would like to interview for this position. We do our best to get back to you individually; however, due to a high volume of responses, it can be that we have not been able to reject your application in person
title: Marketing Manager – Technology & Product Marketing

description: We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our product team, responsible for gathering, analyzing, and translating business requirements into actionable solutions. You will work closely with Product Owners, stakeholders, developers, and QA teams to ensure products are delivered accurately, efficiently, and aligned with business objectives. Key Responsibilities Gather, analyze, and clarify business requirements from stakeholders to ensure feasibility and completeness. Work closely with Product Owner, stakeholders, developers, and QA teams to communicate and validate business requirements. Create and maintain business documentation such as BRD, SRS, User Stories, Use Cases, Wireframes, Workflow, and Data Flow Diagrams. Propose effective solutions that align with business needs and project objectives. Participate in project planning, risk analysis, feasibility studies, and process improvements. Support UAT activities by reviewing test cases and validating that the product meets business requirements. Mentor and provide guidance for junior/mid-level Business Analysts within the team. Requirements 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in software development. Strong knowledge of business analysis techniques, process modeling (BPMN/UML), and documentation writing. Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills; experience working with international clients is a plus. Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Waterfall). Proficiency in BA tools: JIRA, Confluence, Figma, Balsamiq, MS Visio, or similar. English: strong reading/writing skills. Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple tasks, and collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams. Why Join Us Work on diverse and impactful software projects across multiple domains. Professional and collaborative work environment with opportunities to grow. Access to continuous training and career development programs. Competitive salary, negotiable based on skills and experience. Opportunity to work on diverse projects and up-to-date technologies. Friendly and professional team. Full benefits according to Vietnamese labor law.

description: Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Singapore, Group-IB is a leading creator of cybersecurity technologies to investigate, prevent, and fight digital crime. Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses, citizens, and support law enforcement operations. Group-IB’s Digital Crime Resistance Centers (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities. About The Role To become a marketing pioneer at Group-IB Europe, you have to not be afraid of challenges. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative environment. If you're passionate about cybersecurity and marketing, this is your opportunity to be at the forefront of Group-IB’s market presence! Your Mission Bring a strong strategic view and deep understanding of marketing in Europe (DACH region expertise is a strong plus). Develop and execute the European regional marketing strategy, including co-marketing and partner marketing initiatives. Drive and optimize regional campaigns focused on lead generation, demand generation, and brand awareness campaigns; monitor and improve them regularly. Own and manage the regional events calendar, including third-party conferences, co-marketing events, and account-based events from end-to-end planning to execution. Take full ownership of the regional marketing budget planning and allocation, continuously tracking performance and adjusting investments for maximum ROI. Collaborate closely with regional sales teams to gather market feedback, align targets, and integrate field insights into campaign execution. Develop and own the global account-based marketing strategy, setting clear goals for pipeline creation, acquisition, and customer expansion. Design, launch, and optimise integrated, multi-channel campaigns to increase MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline velocity, ensuring alignment with the sales team. Track, analyze, and report on regional marketing performance, providing insights for continuous improvement. Collaborate with the global marketing and intelligence teams to analyze European market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor strategies to refine regional messaging and campaign strategy. Work close to the partner marketing team. What We Are Looking For Degree and/or master's in marketing, business or a related area. 5 to 7 years' experience with similar roles – a focus on cybersecurity is a plus Knowledge of event management (organising, managing and controlling budget). Experience with Salesforce, 6sense, HubSpot, or Marketo is a plus. Excellent analytical skills and ability to generate reports for data-driven decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills to deal with stakeholders and partners/vendors. What Sets You Apart Fluency in German or Dutch is a huge plus. Proven track record of strong relationships with sales teams. Experience with Partner Marketing WHY CHOOSE GROUP-IB Group-IB is a global leader in cybersecurity technologies that investigate, predict, prevent, and fight digital crime. We help organizations reduce risk and protect trust. Trusted by governments, major industries, and law enforcement, we deliver adversary-focused, predictive threat intelligence and cyber fraud fusion solutions that detect, analyse, and mitigate regional and country-specific digital crimes. Work with real stakes. Group-IB investigates active cybercriminal groups, responds to breaches affecting critical infrastructure, and develops technologies used by law enforcement agencies including INTERPOL, Europol, and Afripol across 60+ countries. We've conducted 1,550+ cybercrime investigations alongside 600+ enterprise customers globally. When you join Group-IB, your work directly disrupts digital crime. Grow your way. Choose your own path: deepen your craft as a technical expert, step into leadership, move across to another team, or relocate to one of our Digital Crime Resistance Centers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East & Africa, Central Asia, and the Asia-Pacific. Your growth is our growth — Group-IB's expansion across 60+ active country operations means real career acceleration. We fund professional certifications at company expense — whether you're pursuing CEH, CISSP, OSCP, or specialized certifications in forensics and penetration testing. You don't have to choose between doing the job and advancing your credentials. Work alongside industry leaders. Our Unified Risk Platform — Threat Intelligence, Digital Risk Protection, Attack Surface Management, Managed XDR, and more — is recognized by Gartner, Forrester, KuppingerCole, and Datos Insights. Frost & Sullivan named us a 2025 Global Technology Innovation Leader. When you work here, you're building technologies that set the industry standard. Real challenges, real expertise. You'll take on complex, real-world problems alongside adversary-centric researchers and incident response experts spread across six continents. We've built 21+ years of proprietary telemetry through 1,500+ joint investigations. No two threats look alike — and neither do the skills you'll develop. A team that is genuinely international.
